backup.importMMBakDesc: Import data from Money Manager app backup
backup.mmbakInfo: Import your data from Money Manager app backup file (.mmbak or .db). This will migrate your categories, accounts, and transactions to Cheddar.

backup.formatJsonDesc: Export as ZIP archive with JSON data file. Recommended for backups.
